technician_notes: Compressor contactor CC-8 pitted and arcing, replaced. Run capacitor CAP-11 bulging, replaced as preventive. Filter-drier FD-25 restricted, replaced and system recharged with R-410A to manufacturer spec: 12.4kg charge, superheat 5.8K, subcool 4.2K, all within tolerance. Temperature sensor TS-15 on the leaving water line was reading 3.1K high versus calibrated reference, replaced and verified. Control panel relay RL-12 intermittent under test, replaced. Left system running with all parameters within spec. Recommend follow-up in 14 days to verify stable operation post-recharge, and a review of the contactor replacement schedule given this is the third failure in this compressor circuit within 18 months. Also recommend adding superheat and subcool trending to the BMS for early fault detection.
